observation.command:
cd /workspace
for port in 18007 18008; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port @ line $line ==="
  awk -v l="$line" 'NR<=l && /plausibility|command:|working_dir/ {n=$0} END{print n}' process-compose.yaml
  sed -n "$((line-20)),$((line))p" process-compose.yaml | grep -E 'working_dir|command:' | tail -2
done
